creator: Runway audio generation from RuneCast-specific prompts; Codex source selection, deterministic editing and export for the owner request
source_type: Runway-generated MP3 originals with documented PCM editing and exports
seed_policy: Service generation seed not supplied or returned. Stored export-dither seeds are local quantization settings, not model seeds.
fidelity: Originals are MP3. Decoded floating-point intermediates and 24-bit working WAV masters preserve subsequent editing precision; they do not recover lossless original fidelity.
reproduction: Exact local re-render from retained original MP3s, pinned decoder and editing settings; service regeneration is not claimed deterministic.

rights.summary: General Runway Terms section 4.4 do not claim ownership of outputs or restrict commercial use, subject to compliance with the agreement. No SFX-specific exception identified in reviewed public documentation. Account-specific supplemental terms not independently inspected.
